name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families across India having cultivable agricultural land registered in their name (subject to exclusions for institutional landowners and high income taxpayers).
documents_required: Land Ownership Documents (Khata / Pahani / RTC / 7/12 extract)
Active Mobile Number for e-KYC OTP
last_date: Open Year-Round (Continuous Enrollment & Periodic e-KYC Verification)
verified_by: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
apply_steps: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in > 'Farmer Corner' > 'New Farmer Registration' or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with land RTC and Aadhaar.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefits: Comprehensive yield & crop loss coverage against non-preventable natural risks (drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, pests & diseases, landslide, unseasonal hail/cyclone). Farmer pays only 1.5% premium for Rabi foodgrains/oilseeds, 2% for Kharif crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; balance subsidy is borne 50:50 by Central and State Governments.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance units/panchayats, including loanee farmers and non-loanee sharecroppers/tenant farmers with tenancy proof.
documents_required: Crop Sowing Certificate / Self-Declaration of Sown Crop
last_date: December 31 for Rabi crops / July 31 for Kharif crops
apply_steps: Register via pmfby.gov.in > 'Farmer Corner' or enroll through your crop loan bank branch or nearest CSC before the seasonal cut-off date.

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation Subsidy)
benefits: Financial subsidy of up to 55% for Small & Marginal farmers (landholding up to 2 hectares / 5 acres) and 45% for Other farmers for installing Drip Irrigation and Sprinkler Irrigation systems. Saves 40-50% water while increasing yield by 20-30%.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with an assured water source (Borewell, Tube-well, Canal, Pond). Preference given to water-stressed blocks and small/marginal landholders.
documents_required: Land Ownership Documents (RTC / Pahani / 7-12) showing water source
Electricity Bill / Water Source Certificate (for borewell/tube-well)
last_date: Active Phase (State Directorate of Horticulture / Agriculture portals)
verified_by: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
apply_steps: Apply through your State Horticulture / Agriculture Department portal (e.g., Mahadbt in Maharashtra, Himsugam in Karnataka, e-Krishi) or visit the Block Assistant Director of Horticulture (ADH).

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) - Low Interest Crop Loan
benefits: Short-term institutional crop loan up to ₹3,00,000 at a concessional base interest rate of 7%, further subsidized by 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI), resulting in an effective net interest rate of only 4% per annum. Collateral-free loan up to ₹1,60,000.
eligibility: All farmers—individual/joint owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and self-help groups (SHGs) of farmers.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card & Voter ID / PAN Card
Land Title Records (RTC / 7-12 / Khasra) with crop cultivation proof
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from neighboring lead banks if loan exceeds collateral-free limit
last_date: Open Year-Round across all Commercial, Regional Rural & Cooperative Banks
apply_steps: Download form from myscheme.gov.in or pmkisan.gov.in > 'Download KCC Form', attach land records and submit to your local bank branch where PM-KISAN is credited.

name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹1.25 Lakh to ₹3.5 Lakh depending on machine type) on purchase of modern agricultural equipment: Rotavators, Multi-Crop Seed Drills, Laser Land Levelers, Power Tillers, Combine Harvesters, and Solar Agri-Pumps. Up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) in rural villages.
eligibility: Small, marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers receive highest subsidy priority (50%). All landholding farmers are eligible.
documents_required: Caste / Category Certificate (if claiming affirmative subsidy rate)
Dealer Quotation for the authorized agricultural equipment
last_date: Quarterly Allotment Windows (Check state DBT portal)
apply_steps: Register on the Central AgriMachinery Portal (agrimachinery.nic.in) or state DBT portal, choose the desired machinery model and authorized dealer, and submit the subsidy application.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC)
benefits: 100% free scientific soil testing for 12 key nutrient parameters: Primary (N, P, K), Secondary (S), Micronutrients (Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron), and Physical properties (pH, Electrical Conductivity EC, Organic Carbon OC). Provides customized crop-wise fertilizer dosages to prevent overuse of urea and save ₹3,000–₹5,000/acre.
eligibility: All operational agricultural landholders across all Indian states and Union Territories.
documents_required: Soil sample from farm plot (collected as per block guidelines)
last_date: Open Year-Round at Block Raitha Samparka Kendras (RSK) / Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVK)
verified_by: ICAR & Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
apply_steps: Visit your local Village Agriculture Worker (Kisan Mitra) or nearest KVK/RSK to submit soil samples, or view and download your card directly at soilhealth.dac.gov.in using your Survey Number.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Organic Farming
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000/ha is directly paid to the farmer via DBT for organic inputs (bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, botanical extracts, bio-pesticides) and ₹8,800/ha for organic certification under PGS-India and packaging.
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 or more farmers with a minimum aggregate area of 20 hectares (50 acres) committed to chemical-free organic farming.
documents_required: Farmer Cluster Resolution & Declaration of Chemical-Free Farming
last_date: Active Phase (Cluster Formation via District Agriculture Officer)
verified_by: National Centre of Organic and Natural Farming (NCONF)
apply_steps: Approach your Block Agriculture Officer or Local Organic Resource Agency to enroll your village farmer cluster on the PGS-India portal.

name: PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana)
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 to small and marginal farmers upon attaining the age of 60 years. Modest monthly contribution of ₹55 to ₹200 (matched equally by Central Government 1:1) depending on entry age (18 to 40 years). Contributions can be auto-debited directly from PM-KISAN benefits.
eligibility: Small & Marginal Farmers owning cultivable agricultural land up to 2 hectares (5 acres) between the entry age of 18 and 40 years.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account Passbook / PM-KISAN Account
Land Record extract (RTC / Pahani / 7-12) confirming land under 5 acres
verified_by: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) & MoA&FW
apply_steps: Enroll online through maandhan.in or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) with your Aadhaar and Bank Passbook.

name: NFSM (National Food Security Mission) - Certified Seed Subsidy
benefits: 50% to 60% price subsidy on certified High-Yielding Variety (HYV) and Hybrid seeds of Rice, Wheat, Pulses (Gram, Moong, Urad, Arhar), and Nutri-cereals (Millets). Free demonstration minikits of newly released climate-resilient varieties and bio-fertilizers distributed to farmers.
eligibility: All farmers growing foodgrains and pulses in designated NFSM districts across participating states.
last_date: Prior to Kharif and Rabi Sowing Seasons (May-June and October-November)
verified_by: Crops Division, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
apply_steps: Collect subsidized seed permits from your local Block Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) / Krishi Bhavan or state seed corporation depots before sowing season.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) - Direct Digital Mandi
benefits: Free access to an all-India electronic trading portal connecting 1,361+ APMC mandis across 23 states. Enables farmers to get transparent competitive bidding for their harvest, assaying quality certification, and direct online payment settlement to bank account without middleman commissions.
eligibility: Any farmer with marketable agricultural produce wishing to sell at APMC mandis.
documents_required: Mobile number for SMS lot tracking
Produce sample for laboratory assaying at APMC gate
last_date: Year-Round Active Trading across all registered APMC Mandis
apply_steps: Register online at enam.gov.in > 'Registration' or bring your harvest lot directly to an e-NAM integrated APMC gate for free weighing and electronic bidding.

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme (Millet Promotion)
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2 hectares / ₹20,000) directly credited to the farmer's bank account via DBT for cultivating notified minor millets (Ragi, Foxtail millet / Navane, Little millet / Same, Browntop millet / Korale, Kodo millet / Haraka).
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Karnataka who have sown notified millets and registered their crop on the state FRUITS / e-Parihara portal.
documents_required: FRUITS ID (Farmer Registration & Unified Beneficiary Information System)
Pahani / RTC showing millet crop recorded in current season
verified_by: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka
apply_steps: Register your crop details on the Karnataka FRUITS portal (fruits.karnataka.gov.in) or visit your local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) with your RTC.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pump Subsidy)
benefits: Up to 60% subsidy (30% Central Government + 30% State Government) with 30% bank loan support for installing stand-alone solar agricultural water pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) and solarizing existing grid-connected tube-wells. Eliminates diesel expenses and provides free, reliable daylight power for irrigation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, Water User Associations, and cooperatives possessing cultivable land and borewell/dug well requiring irrigation.
documents_required: Land Record (RTC / 7-12) proving ownership of agricultural land
last_date: Active Phase through State Renewable Energy Development Agencies
verified_by: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), GoI
apply_steps: Apply through your official State Renewable Energy Agency portal (e.g., KREDL in Karnataka, MSEDCL/MEDA in Maharashtra, PEDA in Punjab) or visit the district MNRE nodal office.
